headline: Wardens Recover in Marban Hollow; Weathered Expanse Tilts Colonial
war_summary: Marban Hollow has swung back toward the Wardens, who now fly two banners there against four Colonial and two demolished posts, with Checkpoint Bua again the busiest ground at twenty-six flag actions in the day. Weathered Expanse remains the war's costliest front, nearly fifteen thousand casualties counted in twenty-four hours, and Warden holdings there have fallen from three posts to one, five now Colonial and three in ruin, the fighting thick about Crow's Nest. Nevish Line stands dead even at four banners apiece, the Colonials having restored the two strongpoints lately in rubble while the guns at Princefal spoke into the morning. Kuura Strand remains divided four Colonial to two Warden, Faden Point the most worked shore. At Godcrofts, the post at Argosa, lately fallen to no-man's-land, is back in Colonial keeping. Linn Mercy's exchanges around Lathair cooled toward dawn. Elsewhere quiet prevails: Pari Peak and Olavis Wake have been still since yesterday, and Callahans Passage, without a single flag event, nonetheless counted some six thousand eight hundred casualties. Thirty-four victory towns are required; no victor is declared.
